title: Weakly associated points are unchanged under henselization and strict henselization
author: The Stacks Project Authors
work: Stacks Project, chapter flat.tex (More on Flatness)
source_version: Stacks Project source tree, file flat.tex, corpus local snapshot 20261011
difficulty_reason: The lemma shows that being a weakly associated point of a quasi-coherent module is equivalent to the maximal ideal being a weakly associated prime after pulling the stalk back to the henselization or to the strict henselization (statement lines 379-395, tag 0CTU). One direction is the definition and the flat pullback statement, but the converse needs real work: it descends a witnessing element from the strict henselization to some etale neighbourhood using the colimit description of the strict henselization, uses faithful flatness to identify the annihilator downstairs as an inverse image so that its radical is the maximal ideal, and then applies the up and down lemma for etale neighbourhoods. The descent of the witnessing element is the substance, so the claim is H2.
